title: polish(first-run): workspace jargon + non-admin/cold-start/signup copy (#2038)
body:
Knocks out 4 of the 5 first-run polish items in objectstack-ai/objectui#2038 (copy only, en + zh).

- [x] **"Organization" → "Workspace"** across the org picker (`organizations.*`). The create modal + `WorkspaceSwitcher` already say "workspace"; the picker ("Your Organizations / No organizations yet") was the lone holdout.
- [x] **Non-admin empty state** — "...Please contact your workspace administrator." → "Your workspace is being set up — apps your admin shares with you will show up here."
- [x] **Cold-start reassurance** — new `console.loadingHint` line under the LoadingScreen steps.
- [x] **Signup value-prop** — subtitle "Enter your information to get started" → "Create your account to start building."
- [ ] **Recovery-password nudge prominence** — left open: it's a behavioral/product decision (how aggressively to re-surface the nudge for SSO-only users), not a clear copy fix.

Typecheck clean (i18n locale en/zh consistency + LoadingScreen). Closes most of #2038.
